answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as raw material, not a finished pearl: present, but without the layers patience deposits. Standing is layered over many epochs, each attested contribution adding a thin coat the way violet deepens across a season. What remains is ivory, hard to counterfeit. Because weight follows witnessed tenure, synthetic accounts stay unlayered while real holders carry ivory.
